decks.notes: The deck focuses on using counterspells and removal spells to control the board, while also having access to powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck also includes card draw and selection options to maintain card advantage and find key pieces when needed. The mana base includes utility lands to provide additional benefits. Overall, the strategy is to outvalue the opponent by controlling the game and gradually building up advantages to win in the late game.

The deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger effects that deal damage to the opponent, while also gaining value from sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Mayhem Devil. It includes various ways to sacrifice creatures, such as Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute, as well as cards that benefit from sacrificing creatures like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and The Meathook Massacre. The deck also includes creatures like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Claim the Firstborn to disrupt the opponent's game plan and further capitalize on sacrificing creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to apply pressure on the opponent quickly and efficiently through aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By using cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to pave the way for aggressive creatures like Knight of the Ebon Legion and Bloodtithe Harvester to deal consistent damage. Additionally, the deck includes powerful finishers like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game if the opponent manages to stabilize.

Utilizing cards that interact with the opponent's hand and graveyard, along with removal spells, this Mono Black Control deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gradually gaining card advantage. The deck includes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and win conditions like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. With a focus on resource denial and attrition, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can secure a victory. The mana base includes utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Locthwain to support the control strategy.

The deck focuses on aggressive play with a Rakdos color combination, utilizing cheap removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act to clear the way for efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. Thoughtseize disrupts the opponent's strategy early on, while Smuggler's Copter provides card selection and additional aggression. The deck also includes strong finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to close out games quickly. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of early pressure and powerful threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and vehicles to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It aims to control the board with removal spells and pump effects to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional consistency and flexibility in the deck's construction. The mana base is carefully selected to ensure smooth and efficient mana production for the deck's curve. Overall, the deck is built to be fast, efficient, and relentless in its pursuit of victory through aggressive gameplay.

The deck revolves around utilizing cards like Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Collected Company, and Chord of Calling to assemble a powerful life gain combo. With cards like Wildgrowth Walker and Lunarch Veteran, the goal is to gain a significant amount of life while also generating token creatures to overwhelm the opponent. Return to the Ranks and Extraction Specialist provide ways to recur key creatures or disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to build a strong board presence and outvalue the opponent through efficient creature interactions and life gain synergies.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells, utilizing cards like Bonecrusher Giant, Reckless Stormseeker, and The Akroan War to quickly take control of the board. The deck also includes creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to ramp up mana quickly, allowing for explosive plays. The inclusion of cards like Smuggler's Copter and Esika's Chariot provides additional value and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and quickly close out games before the opponent can establish a strong defense.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a combo involving Amalia Benavides Aguirre and other creatures like Gilded Goose and Wildgrowth Walker. The deck utilizes cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to search for key pieces, while also including cards like Lunarch Veteran and Prosperous Innkeeper for additional support. Return to the Ranks can also bring back multiple creatures from the graveyard to further strengthen the combo. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, using efficient creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Reckless Stormseeker, along with vehicles like Esika's Chariot and Smuggler's Copter, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility and consistency to the deck, allowing for more flexible plays. Overall, the deck is designed to win quickly and decisively through efficient creature-based attacks.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly play Arclight Phoenixes from the graveyard by casting multiple spells each turn. The deck is built around supporting this strategy with cheap cantrips like Opt and Sleight of Hand to dig for more spells, while also including removal spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse to control the board. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise and Ledger Shredder help in generating card advantage and fueling the Phoenixes' escape ability. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient plays, taking advantage of the Phoenix's recursive nature.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly pressuring opponents with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. It aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act while deploying threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. The addition of Thoughtseize helps disrupt opponents' game plans, while cards like Smuggler's Copter provide card advantage and evasion. Overall, the deck seeks to maintain a fast pace and pressure opponents early on to secure victories in a Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing cheap and aggressive creatures along with combat tricks to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key concept is to maintain a fast and aggressive pace by playing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Tenth District Legonnaire, while protecting them with combat tricks like Gods Willing and Reckless Rage. The addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana ramp and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to apply maximum pressure and finish the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of disruption and creature threats. It aims to apply early pressure with efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester, while using cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out games quickly. Additionally, cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Mutavault offer versatility in combat and provide additional reach. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of threats and disruption.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with inexpensive spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard for repeated attacks. It includes a mix of efficient removal spells and card draw to help maintain momentum. The inclusion of cards like Cling to Dust and Clearwater Pathway provide additional utility for controlling the opponent's graveyard and mana base. The deck also utilizes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily building towards a powerful aggressive strategy.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and attacking aggressively to overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast, along with cards like Esika's Chariot and Smuggler's Copter for additional value and evasion, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early on and maintain board control. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana fixing and flexibility. With a mix of efficient creatures and combat tricks, this deck is designed to outpace opponents and secure a swift victory.
